title: Clarify or enforce the source-owner limiter for pinned registration probes
outcome: Source-owner documentation accurately states whether the two-permit limiter covers only GET metadata or also pinned-registration probes, and the chosen admission/resource bound is covered without changing the outer registration POST or ACK contract.
acceptance: The documented limiter scope matches GET metadata and pinned registration/replay behavior; any concurrency admission change preserves existing registration refusal/ACK identity and aggregate deadlines.
Focused coverage demonstrates the chosen limiter scope and no sharing of review-freeze capacity.
